name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set your feet, squeeze the bar, and lower to mid-chest under control. Press up while keeping your shoulder blades pinned back.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set a slight incline and keep wrists stacked over elbows. Press up and slightly in without bouncing at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor and pause triceps on the ground each rep. Press with a tight upper back and neutral wrists.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Brace your core and keep a straight line from head to heels. Lower until chest is near the floor and drive back up.

name: Weighted Push-Up
instructions: Add load securely and keep your elbows at about 45 degrees. Maintain full-body tension throughout.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Keep a soft bend in the elbows and move from the shoulders. Bring hands together in front of the chest and squeeze.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lower with control and keep elbows slightly bent. Stretch across the chest, then squeeze up without clanging dumbbells.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so handles align with mid-chest. Press smoothly and keep shoulders down and back.

name: Chest-Supported Push-Up Hold
instructions: Lower into a strong mid-range push-up position and hold. Keep ribs down and breathe slowly.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Keep your back on the pad and lead with elbows. Squeeze at the front, then return under control.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Start from a dead hang and pull chest toward the bar. Keep ribs down and avoid swinging.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Use a shoulder-width underhand grip and pull smoothly. Control the descent to a full hang.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
instructions: Add weight securely and keep your body tight. Pull high and lower slowly to full extension.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar to upper chest while keeping shoulders down. Control the return and avoid leaning back excessively.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall and row toward your lower ribs. Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then reach forward under control.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace with a flat back and pull elbow toward your hip. Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
instructions: Press chest into the pad and row without jerking. Keep your neck neutral and squeeze at peak contraction.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge to a strong torso angle and keep core braced. Row to your midsection and lower with control.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Keep elbows mostly straight and pull the bar to your thighs. Feel lats engage without shrugging.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull the rope toward your nose with elbows high. Rotate so knuckles point back and squeeze rear delts and upper back.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a long spine and soft knees. Lower until hamstrings stretch, then drive hips forward.

name: Back Squat
instructions: Brace, sit down and back, and keep knees tracking over toes. Stand tall without losing midline tension.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Keep elbows high and torso upright. Descend under control, then drive up through midfoot.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the weight close and keep chest proud. Sit between your hips and stand smoothly.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Keep front foot planted and torso slightly forward. Lower until front thigh is near parallel, then drive up.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step long enough to keep front knee over midfoot. Push through the front heel and keep hips level.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Set feet mid-platform and lower until knees track comfortably. Press without locking out hard.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Set the pad above your ankles and lift smoothly. Pause at the top, then lower without slamming.

name: Hamstring Curl Machine
instructions: Keep hips down and curl through full range. Control the eccentric for better hamstring tension.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto the balls of your feet and squeeze at the top. Lower slowly to a full stretch at the bottom.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Brace your core and press straight overhead. Keep ribs down and lock out with biceps near ears.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press up without arching the lower back. Control down to just below chin level.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Rotate smoothly from palms-in to palms-out as you press. Keep elbows slightly forward and avoid flaring hard.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Lift to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend. Lead with elbows and avoid shrugging.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall and raise the handle out to the side. Keep tension throughout and control the lowering phase.

name: Rear Delt Fly (Dumbbell)
instructions: Hinge forward and sweep arms out wide. Squeeze rear delts and keep neck neutral.

name: Upright Row (Cable)
instructions: Pull up to upper chest with elbows leading. Keep wrists neutral and stop before shoulder pinch.

name: Handstand Hold
instructions: Stack shoulders over hands and keep a tight midline. Hold steady while breathing calmly.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Hips high and head moves toward the floor between hands. Press back up keeping elbows angled slightly forward.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Pull the band apart to shoulder width without shrugging. Pause briefly, then return under control.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Keep elbows pinned to your sides and curl without swinging. Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl with neutral grip and steady torso. Squeeze at the top and control the descent.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Let arms hang back for a full stretch. Curl smoothly and avoid letting elbows drift forward.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Lock elbows by your sides and extend fully. Keep shoulders down and control back up.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
instructions: Keep elbows pointing forward and ribs down. Extend to full lockout, then lower with control.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Use a shoulder-width grip and keep elbows tucked. Lower to mid-chest and press while staying tight.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
instructions: Keep shoulders down and descend under control. Press up without shrugging at the top.

name: Weighted Dip
instructions: Add weight securely and keep a stable torso. Descend smoothly and lock out with control.

name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
instructions: Keep upper arms still and lower the bar toward your forehead. Extend elbows to finish without flaring.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Stand tall and walk with controlled steps. Keep shoulders packed and grip the handles hard.

name: Plank
instructions: Brace as if preparing for a punch and keep hips level. Hold a straight line while breathing quietly.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Stack shoulders and hips and lift into a straight line. Keep hips high and neck neutral.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Press lower back into the floor and extend arms and legs. Hold tension without letting ribs flare.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Keep low back glued to the floor as you extend opposite arm and leg. Move slowly and return with control.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang tall and raise knees toward chest without swinging. Control down to a dead hang each rep.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Keep legs straight and lift using your abs, not momentum. Lower slowly and avoid rocking.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Rotate through the torso with hips stable. Pull diagonally across your body and return under control.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Press the handle straight out and resist rotation. Hold briefly, then bring it back with control.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Roll out slowly while keeping ribs down and hips tucked. Stop before your low back arches and pull back in.

name: Russian Twist (Medicine Ball)
instructions: Lean back slightly and rotate shoulders side to side. Keep feet stable and move smoothly.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop to the floor, kick back, then jump up smoothly. Keep a steady pace and land softly.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at the hips and snap them forward to drive the bell. Keep arms relaxed and spine neutral.

name: Thruster (Dumbbell)
instructions: Squat with control then drive to an overhead press in one motion. Keep core braced and elbows under the weights.

name: Clean and Press (Kettlebell)
instructions: Clean to the rack with a tight wrist, then press overhead. Reset each rep with control and full-body tension.

name: Renegade Row
instructions: Hold a strong plank and row one dumbbell at a time. Minimize hip sway and keep shoulders square.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Stay in a plank and drive knees alternately toward chest. Keep hips low and move rhythmically.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Keep jumps small and land softly on the balls of your feet. Maintain a relaxed grip and steady cadence.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Run tall with a quick, light stride. Set a sustainable pace and keep breathing controlled.

name: Rowing Erg
instructions: Drive with legs first, then hinge and pull to ribs. Recover smoothly and keep strokes consistent.

name: Bike Sprint Intervals
instructions: Accelerate hard for the work interval, then spin easy to recover. Keep effort consistent across rounds.
